solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Proposal one before court entered in flawless film

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put to a meeting for debate

indicators.note: the one and the court go into the word for flawless

parts.note: pure means unblemished, free of flaws

indicators.note: one comes ahead of court inside the container

explanation.surface: A legal motion is filed ahead of a courtroom drama on a pristine film reel.
explanation.definitionFit: A motion picture is the older formal name for a cinema film or movie.

clue.text: Scheming man and evil woman brought up to speed?

parts.note: Mach one, written MACH I, is the speed of sound

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: ill as a noun means harm or wickedness
Eva is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A schemer and a wicked woman are briefed so they are up to speed.
explanation.walkthrough: MACH I is Mach 1, the speed of sound; 'to' simply places the reversed pair after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Niccolo Machiavelli, author of The Prince, gave his name to cunning, unscrupulous political scheming.

clue.text: Citadel without key or lock

indicators.note: the fortress goes on without these letters, so they are dropped from it

parts.note: a citadel is a fortress guarding a city
F is a musical key
taken as written

explanation.surface: A castle stands with no key and no lock to its gates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key or lock' reads like a choice of door fastenings; 'lock' is really the definition, a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress is a long lock of hair, so the definition is the hair sense, not the door fitting.

clue.text: Old fear and hurt transformed in prayer

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new form, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Old fears and pain are turned to something better through prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Our Father is another name for the Lord's Prayer, from its opening words.

clue.text: Game bird losing height — was one entitled to land?

definitions.note: a noun phrase, matching the noun answer; the question mark hedges a loose definition

indicators.note: the game bird loses a letter, so it is taken away

parts.note: the pheasant is the classic shooting bird

explanation.surface: A shot bird falls from the sky and the clue asks if it may land.
explanation.walkthrough: H is the standard abbreviation for height. The question mark admits that a feudal peasant's right to the land was limited.
explanation.definitionFit: A peasant was a small farmer who worked a holding of land, often by customary right under a lord.

clue.text: Conservative treasure split

parts.note: love, like treasure, is a term of endearment for a dear one

explanation.surface: A Tory's prized possession is divided up.
explanation.definitionFit: Clove is a past tense of cleave, to split apart, as in 'he clove the log'.

clue.text: Alban deployed to Sumerian city walls in capital

indicators.note: the city walls in, enclosing the other letters

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Sumer

indicators.note: deployed means spread out, so the letters of Alban are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man called Alban is posted to an ancient city whose walls stand in a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Ulan Bator is the capital of Mongolia.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulan Bator, now usually Ulaanbaatar, is Mongolia's capital city.

clue.text: Odd characters leaving real ale measure

indicators.note: the first, third, fifth and seventh letters go, leaving the even ones

parts.note: the two words are run together, and their even letters are the ones kept

explanation.surface: Strange folk walk out of the pub, leaving their pints of real ale.
explanation.walkthrough: Real ale is British cask-conditioned beer; 'odd characters' looks like eccentric drinkers.
explanation.definitionFit: An ell is an old unit of length, about 45 inches in England, used for cloth.

clue.text: Land covered in Virginia creepers

indicators.note: the letters are wrapped up inside the phrase that follows

parts.note: the word sits across the join of these two words

explanation.surface: A plot of ground is overgrown with Virginia creeper vines.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a measured piece of land, and acres is used generally for land or estates.

clue.text: About A Boy — accomplished and well-thought-out

parts.note: re means concerning, as in a letter heading
taken as written
a son is a boy child
able means skilled or capable

explanation.surface: The film About A Boy is praised as polished and carefully plotted.
explanation.walkthrough: About A Boy is a Nick Hornby novel and film, so the capitals pretend to be a title.
explanation.definitionFit: A reasonable plan is sensible and rational, the result of sound judgment.

clue.text: Tribe owns a housing society in DRC location

indicators.note: the first group of letters gives a home to the abbreviation for society

parts.note: kin are a family group, one's tribe
has means possesses
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tribe owns a housing association somewhere in the Congo.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinshasa is the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

clue.text: The setter backing his editor to provide raise?

indicators.note: going backwards, so the word for the setter is reversed

parts.note: setters refer to themselves as me
a setter's editor is the boss

explanation.surface: A crossword setter supports the editor in a bid to get a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raise' looks like a pay rise; it is the verb, to make a design stand out in relief.
explanation.definitionFit: To emboss is to carve or mould a design so that it stands up from the surface.

clue.text: Master performing reliably in the opening movement?

definitions.meaning: a master key opens every lock in a building

definitions.text: performing reliably in the opening movement
definitions.meaning: reads like a musician dependable in a first movement, but means a device that opens things reliably

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a maestro playing the opening movement of a symphony; the opening is literal, of locks.
explanation.definitionFit: A skeleton key is a key filed down so that it can open many different locks.

clue.text: Bottom's part given full expression too much?

definitions.meaning: part of the name Bottom is the three-letter abbreviation for this phrase, and full expression means spelling it out

explanation.walkthrough: The middle of BOTTOM is OTT, the abbreviation for over the top; 'given full expression' asks for it in full. Bottom also overacts in A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation.definitionFit: Over the top is an idiom for exaggerated or excessive, as in hammy, overdone acting.

clue.text: Rebukes about reversible nose rings

indicators.note: the scolding word goes around the other letters

parts.note: to rate is an old verb for scolding angrily

indicators.note: the word nose is turned to read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is told off over the rings in their nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Resonates means echoes or reverberates, as a bell rings out.

clue.text: Dishes filled with Irish product from hen raised in farms

indicators.note: the dishes contain the other letters as a filling

parts.note: pies are baked dishes

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising means the letters read upwards

parts.note: an egg is what a hen produces

explanation.surface: Pies filled with Irish eggs are brought up on farms.
explanation.definitionFit: Piggeries are pig farms, places where pigs are bred and kept.

clue.text: Fall heavily where hunting party returns

indicators.note: the word comes back on itself, read in reverse

parts.note: a meet is a gathering of hunters and hounds before a hunt

explanation.surface: Rain pours down as the hunt returns home.
explanation.definitionFit: When rain teems it pours down in torrents.

clue.text: Luxurious hotel removed sign of the cross?

indicators.note: the letter for hotel is taken away from the word for luxurious

parts.note: plush means opulent and comfortable

explanation.surface: A smart hotel takes down its crucifix.
explanation.walkthrough: H is hotel in the NATO alphabet. The question mark flags the joke: the plus sign is shaped like a cross.
explanation.definitionFit: The plus symbol is a small upright cross, so it is the sign shaped like a cross.

clue.text: Go for broke with forest where domestic growth high

definitions.note: a phrase describing a place, standing for the noun answer

indicators.note: the two words are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
the Forest of Arden is the setting of As You Like It

explanation.surface: Someone stakes everything on a forest for a garden scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go for broke' is an idiom for risking everything, which disguises the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A roof garden is planted on top of a house or block, so its plants grow up high.

clue.text: Picking scene where killer gets tough?

parts.note: the orc, or orca, is the killer whale
hard means tough or firm

explanation.surface: The scene of a crime is picked out where a murderer turns hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picking scene' suggests choosing a crime scene; it is where fruit is picked.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard is a plantation of fruit trees, the place where apples are harvested.

clue.text: Victory immediately required for fan

parts.note: a win is a victory
now means at once

explanation.surface: A supporter demands a win straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fan' looks like a supporter; it is the verb, to blow air through grain.
explanation.definitionFit: To winnow is to fan or blow grain so the chaff is separated from it.

clue.text: Clears bed clothes after loss

definitions.meaning: first meaning: removes unwanted plants from a garden bed
second meaning: widow's ..., the black mourning clothes worn after a bereavement

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests stripping the bedclothes; the bed is a flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for pulling out unwanted plants and a noun for mourning dress, as in widow's weeds.

clue.text: Burning bodies Shechem at last removed in Genesis

indicators.note: the letter is taken out of the word for burning bodies

parts.note: cremation is the burning of the dead

indicators.note: the final letter of the name is the one meant

parts.note: the name's final letter is used

explanation.surface: A grim scene from Genesis, where the men of Shechem were slain.
explanation.walkthrough: Shechem is a city in Genesis whose men were killed by Jacob's sons, which suits the biblical surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Genesis means origin or beginning, the same as the creation of something.

clue.text: After cheers, negative utterance forbidden

indicators.note: the jeer is placed following the thanks

parts.note: ta and cheers are both informal British thanks
boo is a cry of disapproval

explanation.surface: After applause, booing is not allowed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheers' looks like applause, but in British slang it is a thank-you, as is ta.
explanation.definitionFit: Taboo describes something prohibited by custom or social convention.

clue.text: Celebs get trial arranged to cover the crucial point

indicators.note: the jumbled letters wrap around the other piece
the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
'that's it' names the key point

explanation.surface: Famous people facing court get a trial rigged to hide the key fact.
explanation.definitionFit: The glitterati are fashionable, glamorous celebrities, a blend of glitter and literati.

clue.text: According to Voltaire the wife makes the rules

parts.note: la is French for the, and Voltaire wrote in French

explanation.surface: In Voltaire's household the wife lays down the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Law means the body of rules a society enforces, a collective noun here.

clue.text: Footballer, about to be dropped by United or City

indicators.note: the United letter stands beside, after the shortened word
the abbreviation is left out of the player's position

parts.note: a back is a defensive football player
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A footballer is about to be dropped by Manchester United or City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United or City' looks like the two Manchester clubs; City is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Baku is the capital city of Azerbaijan, on the Caspian Sea.

clue.text: Extra floor announced to hold new sets for musical

indicators.note: the extra contains the rearranged letters

parts.note: in cricket a wide is an extra, a run given away

indicators.note: the letters are made new by rearranging them

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the word for a floor is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: a storey is a floor of a building

explanation.surface: Plans for an extra floor are announced to house new stage sets.
explanation.walkthrough: A wide is a cricket extra, a run scored from a ball bowled out of the batter's reach.
explanation.definitionFit: West Side Story is the Bernstein and Sondheim stage musical updating Romeo and Juliet.
